But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

“On the second day you shall offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering; and they shall cleanse the altar, as…
Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.
He shall make atonement for the Holy Place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their…

According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

translations.web: “ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the first month, in the first day of the month, you shall take a young bull without defect; and you shall cleanse the sanctuary.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the first day of the first month you are to take a young bull without blemish and purify the sanctuary.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish, and cleanse the sanctuary:
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish; and thou shalt cleanse the sanctuary.
